data_schema.title: FMCG Promotion Agent Memory
data_schema.description: Durable memory for a self-learning FMCG promotion agent. Store only three domain objects: SKU, evaluated PromotionCase evidence, and compact Lesson objects that are retrieved before future discount decisions. Do not store prompts, hidden reasoning, simulator internals, or counterfactual actions as separate memory records.

SKU.description: A sellable FMCG item used by the promotion agent. Repeated mentions of the same stable sku_id refer to the same SKU. Keep this object intentionally small; scenario context belongs to PromotionCase rather than to the product master record.

sku_id.description: Stable application SKU identifier exactly as supplied.

name.description: Display product name, for example Ice Cream 500ml.

category.description: Normalised category used to generalise lessons across similar SKUs, for example ice_cream, beer, soft_drinks, chips, meat, or yogurt.

base_price.description: Baseline shelf price before promotion in the scenario currency.

cost.description: Unit cost used by the simulator to calculate gross profit.

PromotionCase.description: One completed promotion decision after the market simulator and counterfactual evaluator have run. It stores scenario context, the discount chosen by the Promotion Agent, the realised outcome, all four counterfactual gross profits, the simulator oracle, and regret. Cases are factual evidence and should be treated as immutable after evaluation except for bad-data fixes.

case_id.description: Stable application case identifier in the form CASE-<simulator_version>-<scenario_id>, for example CASE-v1-SCN-20260718-LONDON_CENTRAL-ICE500.

scenario_date.description: Scenario date normalised as YYYY-MM-DD when supplied.

store.description: Store or store-cluster label, for example London Central.

price.description: Shelf price before the promotion for this scenario.

baseline_sales.description: Expected or historical baseline unit sales before promotion.

stock.description: Units available before the simulated promotion.

stock_level.description: Retrieval bucket derived by application code from stock and baseline demand. Keep only normal and high for the MVP unless low-stock scenarios are introduced.

day_type.description: Coarse timing factor used by both the simulator and lesson retrieval.

weather.description: Coarse weather factor used by both the simulator and lesson retrieval.

temperature_c.description: Forecast or historical temperature in Celsius when available.

event_type.description: Whether a relevant local event is part of the scenario.

event_note.description: Optional descriptive event context, for example concert_nearby. The simulator should use event_type or deterministic application inputs.

chosen_discount.description: Discount percentage chosen by the Promotion Agent and applied in the simulator.

units_sold.description: Units sold for the chosen discount.

gross_profit.description: Gross profit produced by the chosen discount.

profit_0.description: Gross profit from replaying this exact scenario with a 0 percent discount.

profit_10.description: Gross profit from replaying this exact scenario with a 10 percent discount.

profit_20.description: Gross profit from replaying this exact scenario with a 20 percent discount.

profit_30.description: Gross profit from replaying this exact scenario with a 30 percent discount.

best_discount.description: Discount with the highest gross profit when all four actions are replayed.

best_gross_profit.description: Highest gross profit found by replaying all allowed discounts.

regret.description: Gross-profit regret of the chosen action, calculated in code as best_gross_profit minus gross_profit.

regret_pct.description: Regret divided by best_gross_profit and expressed as a percentage. Calculate this in application code rather than deriving it with the model.

Lesson.description: Compact reusable promotion knowledge derived from multiple evaluated PromotionCase records. This is the main memory object read by the Promotion Agent. Repeated evidence for the same deterministic lesson_key updates the same Lesson rather than creating near-duplicate prose lessons.

lesson_key.description: Deterministic key supplied by learner code. Build it from scope plus applicable context buckets, using any for omitted conditions. Example: category:ice_cream|store:any|weekend|hot|event:any|stock:high.

scope.description: Generalisation scope in a simple parseable form such as sku:ICE500 or category:ice_cream.

store_scope.description: Store label when evidence is intentionally store-specific. Leave empty for a lesson intended to generalise across stores.

day_type.description: Applicability condition. Leave empty when the lesson applies to both.

weather.description: Applicability condition. Leave empty when weather is not material.

event_type.description: Applicability condition. Leave empty when event context is not material.

stock_level.description: Applicability condition. Leave empty when stock level is not material.

stock_cover.description: Applicability condition. Stock relative to baseline demand, added because the evidence inside some buckets disagreed along exactly this axis.

recommended_discount.description: Discount currently supported by accumulated simulator evidence.

rationale.description: Short evidence-grounded explanation of why the recommendation works. Preserve concrete effects such as demand response or margin destruction; do not invent causal claims that are not supported by linked cases.

evidence_count.description: Number of linked evaluated cases currently used as evidence.

confidence.description: Learner confidence from 0.0 to 1.0. Compute or validate this in application code from evidence agreement rather than trusting free-form model confidence.

avg_profit_advantage_pct.description: Average gross-profit advantage of recommended_discount over the best alternative among linked cases, expressed as a percentage and calculated in application code.

updated_on.description: Date of the latest lesson update normalised as YYYY-MM-DD.

case_sku.description: Connect each evaluated PromotionCase to the SKU whose promotion was tested.

sku.description: The SKU evaluated in the case.

lesson_evidence.description: Connect a Lesson to every PromotionCase that was actually used as evidence to create or update that lesson. This relation is the primary write -> read trace for the demo.

lesson.description: The reusable lesson supported by evaluated evidence.

case.description: A case used to create, reinforce, or revise the lesson.

lesson_sku_scope.description: Optionally connect a SKU-scoped Lesson directly to the SKU it applies to. Category lessons may omit this relation and use the structured scope field instead.

sku.description: The SKU the lesson directly applies to.
